Acrolein: Reacts with deoxyguanosine and forms DNA crosslinks, DNA-protein crosslinks and DNA adducts
Formaldehyde: DNA-protein crosslinks causing chromosome deletions and re-arrangements
1,3-butadiene: Global loss of DNA methylation (an epigenetic effect) as well as DNA adducts
Acetaldehyde: Reacts with deoxyguanine to form DNA adducts
Ethylene oxide: Hydroxyethyl DNA adducts with adenine and guanine
Isoprene: Single and double strand breaks in DNA
